status: Actual native full, genuine hero and near-shore low inspected review candidate; photographic fidelity unaccepted
implementation: Static 1.4 metric similarity resites the whole midground temple/bridge/stairs and physical practicals against fixed water and near veranda, replacing the old tall pond rock cliff. It has no runtime camera input.
A continuous low earth spine and jointed return walk turn to the eastern mainland, with true corner landings, slope beams, deduplicated rail posts and footings.
Sloping earth beds and mature woody azaleas soften the hall foundation; a low left cherry headland joins the adjacent pine-root island. All new roots use actual modeled soil.
Lantern-island soil and every procedural/scanned plant now share the same real root surface; the former independent implied plant ellipsoid is removed.
Pine needles have rounded normals and corrected millimetre calibres; reflected and transmitted irradiance sample opposite hemispheres of the same spatial capture.
Eight actual native cube captures distinguish lower/upper rooms from porches and low vegetation from exposed crowns in near/far banks.

Vermilion pigment/cedar grain, metric convex-edge coating loss and separate variable clear lacquer replace uniform gray-brown response. Granite reflectance and neutral clay/glaze responses were re-authored.

One static complete world sky drives camera, water reflection and PMREM. Rayleigh clear-air gaps, optical cloud structure, measured HDR unobserved bearings, normalized solar Mie scattering and a solar-lit world cloud bank replace the saturated white sky.
Water uses coherent millimetre wave slopes, matching reflected scene perturbation and actual-sun direct glint; mirror weight and rough reflection are reduced.

Four whole-volume flowering cherries replace main-bough sphere scatter with closed bearing wood, secondary branches, actual floral spurs, pedicels and cupped five-petal umbels. The main cherry is resited to the left rear bank.

The upper hall roof rise is rebuilt from6.15 to7.30 model metres and shared by all actual tile surfaces, gable work and queried bearing seats. Hall body, main stair head, sanctuary, actual practicals and four hall radiance captures are lowered by0.20 model metres (0.28 world metres).

Cherry petal surface triangles, colors and positions are bit-identical to R17, with shared cup-boundary vertices and continuous normals. Flower buffers reduce from80,870,400 to39,312,000 bytes per tree without lowering geometric flower count.
